title: A lift of the colored Jones polynomial of a knot
summary: Habiro lifted the Witten-Reshetikhin-Turaev invariant of an integer homology 3-sphere (a complex-valued function on the set of complex roots of unity) to an element of the Habiro ring. We lift the colored Jones polynomial of a knot, with Alexander polynomial $Δ(t)$, to the recently introduced Habiro ring of the étale map $\mathbb{Z}[t^{\pm 1}]\to \mathbb{Z}[t^{\pm 1},Δ(t)^{-1}]$ (with Frobenius lifts $t\mapsto t^p$ for all primes $p$).
